steps.npc: Hi. How can I help?

steps.text: If the player is on a PvP world:

steps.npc: Sorry, I'm not on duty.

steps.text: If the player is on a Deadman world:

steps.npc: PLEASE DON'T KILL ME!

steps.player: I was... looking to be healed.

steps.npc: No way, I'm out of here just as soon as I've packed up my stuff!

steps.text: If the player has full Hitpoints:

steps.npc: You look healthy to me!

steps.text: If the player does not have full Hitpoints:

steps.npc: Of course!

steps.text: Surgeon General Tafani heals you for 21 Hitpoints.

options.text: Do you see a lot of injured fighters?

steps.player: Do you see a lot of injured fighters?

steps.npc: Yes I do. Thankfully we can cope with almost anything. Jaraah really is a wonderful surgeon, his methods are a little unorthodox but he gets the job done.
I shouldn't tell you this but his nickname is 'The Butcher'.
I work here, so yes!
You're silly!

options.text: Can you tell me about your cape?
options.condition: If the player does not have 99 Hitpoints:

steps.player: Can you tell me about your cape?

steps.npc: Certainly! Skillcapes are a symbol of achievement. Only people who have mastered a skill and reached level 99 can get their hands on them and gain the benefits they carry.
The Cape of Hitpoints doubles the speed of your hitpoints replenishing when worn. Is there anything else I can help you with?

options.text: Can I buy a Skillcape of Hitpoints from you?

steps.text: If the player is on a PvP Arena world:

steps.player: Can I buy a Skillcape of Hitpoints from you?

steps.npc: Sorry, I'm under orders to not sell capes right now.

steps.text: You cannot do that on this game world.

steps.player: Can I buy a Skillcape of Hitpoints from you?

steps.npc: Why, certainly my friend. However, owning such an item makes you part of an elite group and wearing it will double the speed of your hitpoints replenishing.
Such a privilege will cost you 99,000 coins.
I'm sorry you feel that way. Still if you change your mind...

options.text: Sure, that's not too expensive for such a magnificent cape.

steps.player: Sure, that's not too expensive for such a magnificent cape.

steps.text: If the player does not have at least 99,000 coins:

steps.player: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.

steps.npc: Well come back and see me when you do.

steps.text: If the player has at least 99,000 coins but not enough inventory space:

steps.npc: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.

steps.text: If the player has at least 99,000 coins and enough inventory space:

steps.npc: Wear this cape in good health, my friend.

steps.player: May I have another hood for my cape, please?

steps.npc: Most certainly, and free of charge!

steps.text: Tafani hands you another hood for your skillcape.
